steps.content: [Ceto's Flashback] [Coastal Storm]

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Lighthouse Seven to HQ! All units, respond! The Black Tide has breached the first line! Requesting immediate backup! I repeat, emergency backup required!

The dry, scorching sands were abruptly drowned under a tide of viscous black liquid. The black water surged across the borders of WhiteSands with monstrous speed. Miles away, the piercing signal beams of Lighthouse One and Three were snuffed out one by one, like fragile stars devoured by an advancing void.
Ceto's hands trembled as she frantically hammered the unresponsive transmitter.

steps.speaker: Rode, Lighthouse Seven Keeper
steps.content: It's... no use. The signal's gone. It can't get through...
A relentless tide of horrors crawled from the foul ooze, converging on Lighthouse Seven. The isolated lighthouse keepers prepared for their last stand.

Rode heaved his massive alloy shield into place, but the sturdy metal was no protection. Sinister black patterns crawled across its surface, a living corruption that immediately began seeping into his arms.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Rode!!!

steps.speaker: Rode
steps.content: Ceto, stay back! Go... find the Captain. Now!
Young Ceto started for him, but a piercing shriek from Jay cut her off. His legs were enveloped by crawling things from the black water, flesh vanishing to reveal gleaming bone.
Lia lunged to pull him to safety, but the contamination moved faster than she could. Her hands, acting against her will, snatched the curved blade from her waist and stabbed it toward Jay's heart.

steps.speaker: Lia
steps.content: I can't... I don't know what to do! Ceto, help me, I don't want to—
Her ragged scream was severed as a monster surged from the tide and wrenched her head from her body.
Through a haze of tears, young Ceto swung her dagger, a helpless witness as the insidious black slime swallowed the last traces of her comrades.

...It's coming... the slaughter we crave. ...Kill them all... the gunpowder is whispering my name... Yes... this is who I am, who we are... Tear them open! Grind them to dust! Listen! The song of ruin is played in the slaughter. Hack. Stab. Crush. Savor the taste of blood!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Shut up! Captain... I have to find the Captain. She'll know what to do...
[Flash to Lighthouse Top]

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: C-Captain?

Weakly slumped against the beacon light, Fynn used her longsword to prop herself up, her trembling hands fumbling over the SOS controls. She turned at the sound of Ceto's approach. Young Ceto saw it then: a swirl of crimson corruption in her right pupil, a venomous bloom overtaking the iris.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Why are you... up here...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: The other lighthouses have gone silent. DisCity isn't responding to our SOS. Lia and the others... they're...

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Come here. Give me a hand.
She guided Ceto's hands onto the cold metal of the control lever. Then, she stepped behind her, pressing down her blade with all her remaining strength to keep it from impaling the child before her.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Tell me! Where does this lighthouse point?!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Toward your homeland. DisCity.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Recite the Lighthouse Keeper's Code!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Rule Number One: Signal and Surveillance! Monitor the border without fail. Ensure signal transmission. Report all enemy movement. We are the frontline guardians. We fear nothing, and are ready to sacrifice all for the city-state!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Rule Number Two: Beacon Maintenance! The light is our most reliable signal. Keeping the lighthouses operational is our primary duty!

Her young voice rang out, firm and clear, its resonance carried by the lighthouse beam across the dark sea. Fynn gazed at the small, straight-backed silhouette before her. A faint smile touched her lips as she stepped backward...

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Good... That's right. You must believe... you must believe there's still clean land out there. Stand facing it, fight for it, and never, ever let the lighthouse beacon go out. Until rescue comes... You must survive!
The sound came from behind Ceto—the sickening, unmistakable thrust of a longsword piercing flesh. Yet when Fynn spoke, her voice carried a final, undeniable trace of joy.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Lead the others and keep them alive. You are our hope now...

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Now, this is an order... do not look back.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: ...Yes, Captain!
A heavy impact sounded from the lighthouse top, followed by the distant, splash as something—or someone—plunged into the churning black sea below.
You failed. They died on your watch... Weak. Pathetic... You just stood there! Die, embrace your fate...
[End of Flashback] [Beach at Night, Crashing Waves]

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: AAAAAAAAHHHHHHH—

The downpour hammers her face, streaming in icy rivulets into her collar. Her muscles have turned to steel cables, frozen stiff by the chill. Every time she raises her arm, her blade cuts through the air with a sluggish whoosh.
Unworthy... you lack the will... How lucky. You're alive because they died... Why are you still alive...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Why am I still alive...
She swings without aim, listening to the wet tear of monster flesh. An unsettling smile spreads across her face as she deliberately wades deeper into the churning Black Tide.
...Blood... blood is the true medal of a soldier... Drain them dry, kill them all...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Kill them all...

Monsters pounce like ravenous wolves, their fangs ripping her open. She offers no resistance, letting them maul her freely. The rain sluices over her wounds, diluting the blood into a thick, dark fluid that runs in rivers down her body and into the sea.

steps.speaker: Voice in Mind
steps.content: Blood... blood...

Staggering through the horde, her blade flashes erratically, severing claws and splitting spines by instinct alone. Her consciousness drifts further on the sounds of water and thunder, until the world begins to fade to a featureless white—and then—
Something yanks her back with tremendous force.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Bastard, get out of my way!
She kicks the "monster" away, but it surges back, grabbing her from behind.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: You dogs... still not full? Lia... Fynn... you didn't even leave their bones!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Fine! I'll cut your bellies open... dig out my comrades... give them back to me!
Ceto twists free, drawing her blade, but the "monster" tackles her to the ground, pins her limbs, and wrestles the knife from her grip.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Hahaha... scared now? Scared to die? Scared I'll drag you into the muck and suck your filthy blood dry?!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Ptui!

With a violent heave, she shoves her opponent away, then lunges forward, reversing their positions. Now she is on top, pinning the "monster" beneath her as the merciless rain stitches their flesh and blood together.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: I'm not afraid of you... I've got nothing left! Come on!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: I'm a monster now anyway!

Though a ferocious grin is carved into her face, something hot and salty mixes with the rain, falling onto your skin. The pressure of her hands intensifies, the knife trembling above your head, ready to split you open.

options: Look at me! See who I am!

steps.content: Ceto!
She doesn't listen, driving her full weight down to grind you into the sharp gravel.
Ceto... open your eyes...
The vise of her legs tightens around your ribs; the ache in your chest sharpens into a scream. Your grip on her wrist trembles violently as the blade descends, inching closer to your face.

steps.speaker: Voice in Mind
steps.content: It's here! Fresh... kill... flesh... that shouldn't be here...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Blood... you want blood? Fine. I'll give you blood... kill them all... this should've ended long ago!
Wake up!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: I am awake! I watched them die... right in front of me. There's no one left... no lighthouse keepers... NO ONE!
The rain is a shroud of ice, but where your bodies meet, her skin is a furnace of sticky, inexhaustible rage. Staring into her lifeless eyes, a strange thought flashes through your mind...
She looks like a reflection of yourself, had you lost Hella.
Your strength is failing. As the dagger begins its final, fatal plunge, your weak shackles suddenly pierce her body. The blade jerks to a halt, hovering a mere centimeter from your pupil.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: ...It's you...
It's me. DisCity sent me. I'm here to take you all home.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Liar... you're lying to me again...
We found you too late. But it's not over. You're still here. You're the one who continues the hope.
She shakes her head, trying to pull away, but the effort is too much. She collapses back into you, her body going limp with exhaustion...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Heh... DisCity...

In her daze, a voice seems to slice through the storm's roar and the monsters' howls. It's calling her name. She lifts her heavy head, her eyes finding the chaotic night sky, a void choked with dark clouds.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Look up. Look out at the horizon.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Stand facing it, fight for it, and never, ever let the lighthouse beacon go out.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: You have to believe a better world is waiting out there.
